title: TRCM: Topology-Aware Route-Consistency Modeling for Robust Neural Vehicle Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization has enabled fast constructive solvers for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), yet most autoregressive models still construct solutions through sequential node selection and represent route organization only implicitly. We investigate whether route-level customer co-assignment can be modeled explicitly and used to guide this node-level decision process. To this end, we propose TopologyAware RouteConsistency Modeling (TRCM), which reuses node representations from a standard autoregressive construction pipeline to predict pairwise same-route probabilities and injects them into customer selection as a route-consistency signal. Because sameroute supervision is both class-imbalanced and structurally uneven, TRCM combines structure-preserving augmentation with Topological Entropy (TE)- based reweighting to emphasize locally ambiguous customer pairs. translated_title: TRCM：面向鲁棒神经车辆路径规划的拓扑感知路径一致性建模
translated_abstract: 神经组合优化已经为带容量约束的车辆路径问题实现了快速的构造式求解器，然而大多数自回归模型仍然通过顺序节点选择来构造解，并且仅隐式地表示路径组织方式。我们研究了能否显式地建模路径级别的客户共分配，并将其用于指导节点级的决策过程。为此，我们提出了拓扑感知路径一致性建模（TRCM），该方法复用标准自回归构造流水线中的节点表示来预测成对同路径概率，并将其作为路径一致性信号注入客户选择过程。由于同路径监督既存在类别不平衡又存在结构不均匀的问题，TRCM 将结构保持增强与基于拓扑熵（TE）的重新加权相结合，以强调局部模糊的客户对。在相同解码预算下，TRCM 降低了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 TRCM 方法，复用自回归构造流水线中的节点表示显式预测成对同路径概率并作为一致性信号注入节点选择，结合结构保持增强与拓扑熵重加权，从而在相同解码预算下提升神经求解器解决车辆路径问题的性能与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: TRCM explicitly models route-level customer co-assignment by predicting pairwise same-route probabilities from autoregressive node representations, using structure-preserving augmentation and topological entropy reweighting to achieve more robust neural vehicle routing under matched decoding budgets.
